title: Talking About Family
summary: Хоёр хүн хүүхдүүдийнхээ тухай ярилцаж байгаа нь.

source.name: LIDA Stories

changes: Images and audio removed; the picture-book pages were joined into paragraphs (one page per paragraph).

questions.prompt: What do the two people talk about?
questions.explain: Эхнийх нь "Do you have any family?" гэж асуугаад хоёулаа хүүхдүүдийнхээ тухай ярьсан.
"Mina is four years old. She goes to preschool" гэж хэлсэн. Мириам арван настай.

questions.prompt: What does the son's mother want him to do after he graduates?
questions.explain: Хүү нь ажилд орохыг хүсдэг ч ээж нь "I tell him he should go to university instead" гэж хэлсэн.
